title: Chopped Salad With Herbs
description: Adapted from ‘‘How to Cook Everything,’’ by Mark Bittman. Rather than chopping all the ingredients, you could make these with match-stick like pieces, matching the shape of the haricots verts.
ingredients: 1 pound haricots verts, trimmed, steamed, cooled and cut in half or so
2 medium cucumbers, peeled, seeded and chopped
2 red peppers, peeled, cored, seeded and chopped
1 cup chopped parsley, basil, dill, chervil, mint or (preferably) an assortment
3 tablespoons sherry vinegar or lemon juice, or more to taste
Salt and black pepper to taste
directions: Combine vegetables in a bowl with the herbs. Pour the olive oil and vinegar over all and sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. Toss the ingredients, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
